channel.title: Marin Independent Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Marin Independent Journal (marinij.com)

item.title: San Rafael renews contract with crisis response team
item.description: The SAFE Team specializes in behavioral health emergencies, giving police and firefighters more time for other priority calls.

item.title: Marin wins big ruling against $12M racial lawsuit by former prosecutor
item.description: A judge granted the county summary judgment in the case filed by Otis Bruce Jr., who sought $12 million in damages for alleged retaliation.

item.title: 49ers defensive end Keion White shot in ankle in San Francisco, team says
item.description: A San Francisco 49ers defensive end, Keion White, was shot in the ankle early Monday in San Francisco, suffered non-life-threatening injuries, and is recovering as police investigate the shooting with no arrests announced.

item.title: Mill Valley council prepares ambitious two-year work plan
item.description: The council has nearly 60 projects it wants to accomplish or launch over the next two years.

item.title: Boys soccer: Sophomore striker leads Terra Linda past Branson
item.description: Sophomore Duke Elkington scored a tone-setting early goal then added a second to give the Terra Linda High boys soccer team the breathing room it needed to see out a 2-1 home win against Branson in the first round of the MCAL playoffs on Monday.

item.title: Tillman pleads guilty to burning San Jose post office
item.description: The brother of the late NFL player Pat Tillman faces up to five years in prison.

item.title: San Francisco teachers strike over wages, health benefits
item.description: The school district closed all 120 of its schools and said it would offer independent study to some of its 50,000 students.

item.title: Gui Santos, Brandin Podziemski come up clutch in thrilling win over Grizzlies
item.description: Warriors beat Grizzlies with epic comeback

item.title: Boys basketball: Redwood clamps down on San Rafael, Shapiro
item.description: Redwood High’s must-do list was short for Monday’s opening round of the MCAL boys basketball playoffs against visiting San Rafael. It started and ended with stopping San Rafael’s high-scoring guard Luke Shapiro. item.title: Girls basketball: Spaulding leads Branson past Archie Williams
item.description: The Branson School girls basketball program is in good hands thanks to first-year coach Kayden Korst and sophomore point guard Kate Spaulding.
